//: The workspace root. It exists for THREE reasons, in order of how much they cost when it was missing: (1) yarn is the fleet's package manager (decision 2026-06-18 'use yarn, never npm/npx') and Berry wants one lockfile at one root; (2) the e2e harnesses had nowhere to declare Playwright, so ci.yml ran an unpinned `npm install playwright` twice per run and a `--with-deps` apt call that stalled for six hours on 2026-08-19; (3) `no root manifest` was load-bearing in half a dozen comments — every one of them a workaround for this file's absence. NOTE: no `type` field, deliberately. web/, server/ and e2e/ each declare their own, and setting one here would change the module format of any file they do not cover.
name: queuepilot

scripts.build: yarn workspace queuepilot-web run build && yarn workspace queuepilot-server run build
scripts.install-playwright-browser: yarn workspace queuepilot-e2e run playwright install chromium --with-deps
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace queuepilot-web run typecheck && yarn workspace queuepilot-server run typecheck && yarn workspace queuepilot-e2e run typecheck
